Questions

Straight answers.

What does the free audit actually include?

We go through your site the way a customer does: on a phone, in a hurry. Speed, clarity, trust, how easy it is to call you, how you show up on Google. You get a short, plain-English list of what's costing you enquiries, in order of what to fix first.

No website yet. Is this still for me?

Yes. Tell us what you do and who you do it for, and we'll send back a working preview of your new site within 48 hours. Free.

How much does it cost?

Fixed packages from $999. You get the exact number in writing before we start, and it doesn't change. Hosting is included and you own everything.

How fast can it be live?

Between 5 and 28 days, depending on the size of the site. You'll know the date before you sign.

Can you promise I'll rank first on Google?

No, and be wary of anyone who does. We build every site the way Google rewards: fast, clean, properly structured, with local schema. Then we track what happens.

What happens after launch?

The first year of changes and fixes is on us. After that, leave it running at no cost, send changes at $30 an hour, or edit it yourself.
